primary_training: original main train only, 52892; no refit on validation
selection_reason: retain stage5 preregistered seed42 recommendation; unstable seed gain disclosed; do not choose again using test
main_metric: six-class Macro-F1 if all classes supported; supported-class Macro-F1 otherwise, labelled explicitly

loco.validation: other cars main validation, diagnostic only, no selection
loco.config_source: outputs/建模实验/参数.json; fixed stage4 initial settings, no fold tuning
loco.warning: Main depth24 selection used held-car development labels; do not call it clean LOCO. Supplement uses fixed initial A models and separate fitting per fold. Prior full-data exploration disclosed.

episode_evaluation.scope: main test primary model only; known-variable fixed existing episodes
episode_evaluation.any_alarm_detected: at least one prediction !=0 inside true episode
episode_evaluation.any_correct_class: at least one prediction equals true episode class
episode_evaluation.no_correct_class: no prediction equals true class, including wrong nonzero classes
episode_evaluation.onset: prediction at first observed record; observed delay to first detected record, no future warning claim

error_review: after frozen evaluation only: variable/class confusion, train seen/unseen value, quality flags, deterministic largest-error groups and cases; no feedback tuning
probabilities: uncalibrated; fixed classes0..5; absent training class probability0; argmax ties choose lowest class
intervals: No row-iid confidence intervals; report segment counts and small-car limits
final_test_policy: One frozen primary evaluation; exact independent rerun is verification, not repeated selection. No threshold/model/feature adjustment from results.
